candidates.name: Dumbbell Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Curl Novice 1 Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length. 2 Raise one dumbbell and twist your forearm until it is vertical and your palm faces the shoulder. 3 Lower to original position and repeat with opposite arm Remove Ads

candidates.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Hammer Curl Novice 1 Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling). 2 Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height 3 Return to starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Reverse Curl Novice 1 Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists. 2 Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row Intermediate 1 Hinge forward at the hips while maintaining a flat back. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for. 2 Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl Novice 1 Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling). Seated on an incline bench. 2 Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height 3 Return to starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl Novice 1 Lay on an incline bench. 2 Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists. 3 Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Incline Zottman Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Incline Zottman Curl Intermediate 1 Lay on an incline bench with your palms facing forward. 2 Flex at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps. 3 When you hit the top of the movement, rotate your palms and then lower the dumbbells slowly.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Preacher Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Preacher Curl Novice 1 Start with a with a dumbbell in one hand and your elbow resting on the bench. 2 From this starting position, curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary on the bench.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Spider Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Spider Curl Beginner 1 Lay on an incline or preacher curl bench. 2 Let your arms hang freely off the edge of the bench. 3 Fully flex your elbow and fully extend your elbow on each rep.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Spider Curl Beginner 1 Start by placing your forearms on a flat bench and holding a dumbbell in each hand. 2 From this starting position, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged. 3 Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Twisting Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Twisting Curl Novice 1 Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand. 2 Bring the dumbbells to your sides, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent. 3 From this starting position, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders while rotating your wrists so that your palms face your shoulders at the top of the movement.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Concentration Curl Beginner 1 Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight. 2 Lean forward and place your elbow on the inside of your leg. 3 Curl the dumbbell while keeping your elbow against your leg. Make sure to fully extend your elbow on each rep.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Alternating Pendlay Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Alternating Pendlay Row Advanced 1 The dumbbells should be set on the ground. Hinge forward while keeping a flat back. 2 Pull one elbow back toward the ceiling and then return the dumbbell to the ground softly. 3 Then pull with the other arm. Remove Ads

candidates.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Single Arm Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Kneeling Single Arm Row Novice 1 Place one hand and one knee on a bench. Make sure you keep a flat back. 2 Pull the dumbbell toward the ceiling. 3 Make sure to avoid any jerking or rotating.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Laying Incline Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Laying Incline Row Novice 1 Lay on an incline bench that is between 30-45 degrees high. 2 Let your arms hang freely. Pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Pendlay Row Intermediate 1 The dumbbells should be placed on the floor. 2 Hinge forward with a flat back and grab the dumbbells. 3 Pull both dumbbells back and your elbows toward the ceiling. 4 Return the dumbbells back to the floor softly on each rep.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Row Novice 1 Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand. 2 Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground. 3 From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so. 4 Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row Knee
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Row Knee Novice 1 Start by placing your elbow on one knee. 2 Hold a dumbbell in your other hand, with your palm facing inwards towards your body. 3 From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged.

candidates.name: Lawnmower Row
candidates.cardText: Lawnmower Row Intermediate 1 Stand with feet staggered and one hand on a bench/box. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand. 2 Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat, and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders. 3 Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row Beginner 1 Stand with feet staggered and one hand on your knee. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand. 2 Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat, and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders. 3 Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Supinated Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Supinated Row Beginner 1 Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back. 2 The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise. 3 Let your arms hang freely, maintain an underhand grip, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Preacher Curl Novice 1 Sit at preacher bench, hold dumbbells in each hand with arm extended, palm facing up. 2 Curl dumbbells towards shoulder, keeping upper arm stationary and elbows in. 3 Lower dumbbell slowly back to start.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Incline Curl Novice 1 Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on an incline bench. 2 Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height 3 Return to starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Weighted Chin Ups
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Weighted Chin Ups Advanced 1 Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs. 2 With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar. 3 Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Laying Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Laying Curl Beginner 1 Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on a bench. 2 Start with the dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling, then lower the dumbbells toward your sides. 3 Fully extend your elbows, but don't let your upper arm fall behind your torso.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Flat Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Bench Braced Flat Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling. 2 Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Hammer Flat Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Bench Braced Hammer Flat Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling. 2 Take a neutral grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Hammer Incline Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Bench Braced Hammer Incline Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor. 2 Take a neutral grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Incline Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Bench Braced Incline Curl Beginner 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor. 2 Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Reverse Flat Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Bench Braced Reverse Flat Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling. 2 Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor. 2 Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows. 3 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor. 4 Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Rolling Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Bench Braced Rolling Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling. 2 Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Flat Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Flat Curl Beginner 1 Lay off the side of a bench with the back of your working arm pressed into the side of the bench. Keep your hips all the way up. 2 Fully extend your elbow and feel a stretch through your bicep, then curl. 3 Stop before the dumbbell is pointed at the ceiling to keep tension on your biceps.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Hammer Flat Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Hammer Flat Curl Beginner 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling. 2 Use a hammer grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Hammer Incline Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Hammer Incline Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips down. 2 Take a neutral grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Incline Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Incline Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor. 2 Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Reverse Flat Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Reverse Flat Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling. 2 Use an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl Intermediate 1 Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor. 2 Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Drag Curl Beginner 1 Hold dumbbells at sides with palms forward and elbows tight to body. 2 Curl dumbbells by dragging them along torso, moving elbows behind you. 3 Squeeze biceps at top, then lower slowly to start position.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Incline Twisting Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Incline Twisting Curl Novice 1 Sit on incline bench holding dumbbells at sides, palms facing inward. 2 Curl one dumbbell while twisting palm toward shoulder. 3 Lower slowly, then repeat with opposite arm.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Curl Novice 1 Hold a dumbbell with an underhand grip. Seated on an incline bench. 2 Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height 3 Return to starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Reverse Curl Novice 1 Lay on an incline bench. 2 Grab a dumbbell with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists. 3 Flex at the elbows until your bicep touches your forearm. Try not to let your elbow flair outward.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Hammer Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Hammer Curl Novice 1 Sit on incline bench holding one dumbbell with a neutral grip with arm hanging straight down. 2 Curl dumbbell toward shoulder without moving upper arm. 3 Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full stretch.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Twisting Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Twisting Curl Novice 1 Sit on incline bench holding dumbbell at side, palm facing inward. 2 Curl dumbbell while twisting palm toward shoulder.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Curl Novice 1 Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward. 2 Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, keeping elbow close to your torso. 3 Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to starting position.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Hammer Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Hammer Curl Novice 1 Hold dumbbell at side with palm facing inward, elbow tight to body. 2 Curl dumbbell upward while maintaining neutral grip throughout. 3 Lower under control, keeping tension on biceps and forearm.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Reverse Curl Novice 1 Hold dumbbell with palm facing down and arm straight by your side. 2 Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, leading with back of hand. 3 Lower slowly to starting position, keeping wrist stable.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Twisting Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Twisting Curl Novice 1 Hold dumbbell with palm facing inward and arm extended fully. 2 Curl upward while rotating palm to face shoulder at the top. 3 Squeeze bicep, then lower dumbbell, rotating back to start.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Zottman Curl Beginner 1 Hold dumbbells at sides, palms facing forward, elbows tight to body. 2 Curl both dumbbells up, then rotate palms downward at the top. 3 Lower slowly with palms facing the floor, controlling the descent.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Seated Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Seated Curl Novice 1 Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward. 2 Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping elbows tight to torso. 3 Squeeze biceps, then lower slowly to full extension.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl Novice 1 Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing inward. 2 Curl dumbbells toward shoulders while maintaining neutral grip throughout. 3 Squeeze biceps, then lower slowly to starting position.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Curl Beginner 1 Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing downward. 2 Curl dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping wrists stable and elbows tucked. 3 Lower slowly to full extension, maintaining control throughout.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Hammer Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Hammer Curl Novice 1 Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with palm facing inward. 2 Curl dumbbell toward shoulder while keeping elbow tight to your torso. 3 Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Reverse Curl Beginner 1 Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with palm facing downward. 2 Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, keeping wrist stable and elbow tucked. 3 Lower slowly to full extension while maintaining control.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Seated Zottman Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Seated Zottman Curl Beginner 1 Sit tall holding dumbbells at sides with palms facing forward. 2 Curl dumbbells up, then rotate palms downward at the top. 3 Lower slowly with palms down, controlling the entire descent.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Hammer Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Hammer Curl Novice 1 Stand or sit tall holding dumbbell at your side with palm facing inward. 2 Curl dumbbell toward shoulder while keeping elbow tight to torso. 3 Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension under control.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Pendlay Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Pendlay Row Intermediate 1 Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor. 2 Grab dumbbell from floor with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced. 3 Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower dumbbell fully back to the floor each rep.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Rear Delt Row Intermediate 1 Hinge at hips with back flat, holding dumbbell under shoulder with arm extended. 2 Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt. 3 Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Hammer Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Hammer Curl Novice 1 Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with palm facing inward. 2 Curl dumbbell toward shoulder while keeping elbow tight to your torso. 3 Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension under control.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Curl Novice 1 Sit tall holding dumbbell at your sides with palm facing forward. 2 Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping elbow tight to torso. 3 Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension. 4 Sit tall holding dumbbell at your sides with palm facing forward. 5 Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping elbow tight to torso. 6 Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Zottman Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Zottman Curl Intermediate 1 Sit tall holding dumbbell at your side with palm facing forward. 2 Curl dumbbell up, then rotate palm downward at the top. 3 Lower slowly with palm down, controlling the entire descent.

candidates.name: Dumbbell Flat Preacher Curl
candidates.cardText: Dumbbell Flat Preacher Curl Novice 1 Start with a with a dumbbell in one hand and your tricep resting on flat bench. 2 From this starting position, curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary on the bench.
